Lionel Messi featured in Spider-Man promotional content with Tom Holland

Football star Lionel Messi has appeared alongside actor Tom Holland in a promotional video for 'Spider-Man Brand New Day.' The collaboration, which sees Messi engaging with the Spider-Man universe, has generated significant fan reaction online. The video is part of a marketing campaign for the Spider-Man franchise.
